notes: Ambiguities: (1) The user said 'skip confirmation' but SKILL.md Phase 1.5 literature check needs network and a fingerprint; I ran related_search.py in strict mode with at most 7 counted queries and left a 2021-2022 coverage gap. (2) The query word limit (4 concept words) made claim queries awkward and the first C1 query returned off-topic software-engineering papers. (3) Phase 1.6 asks the Synthesizer to drop weaknesses already answered, but with one shared context the 'dropped' items are ones I drafted mentally and removed; the table is therefore partly reconstructive. (4) The paper text is 536 KB with heavy whitespace, NUL bytes and figure-axis garbage; tables 4 and 5 were garbled so per-method Crafter numbers could not be verified. Bash pipes and sed on the paper needed approval, so I read it via Read/grep only. (5) The EIC step says 'read the paper briefly' but the EIC here is the same context as all reviewers, so verification is partly self-confirming. (6) Pool-position band and Overall consistency rule ('Overall 4 requires pool >= 65') was easy to follow; the script flagged no warnings. (7) The script's ICLR label for final 3 is '4 on {0,2,4,6,8,10}', which a reader could misread as the skill's Overall 4.
